{{Top|leg}}
'''Bedjies''' were small, dark fungi grown in tanks. They grew in a [[Standard week|week]], and became refugee fare during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. They were apparently rather large; [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] ate them in at least two bites. They were apparently large enough to note that [[Randa Besadii Diori]] could eat them whole with his gaping maw. They were very bland, although herbs belonging to the [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] could apparently improve the taste. They were often served steamed.<ref name="Balance Point">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>
